No_Tracking_Please.name: No Tracking Please
No_Tracking_Please.summary: Blocks enemy position-reveal requests and quickhack trace acceleration.

UndiscoverMe.name: UndiscoverMe
UndiscoverMe.summary: Reveals eligible undiscovered vanilla map markers with persistent M1 Arc settings and a native REDscript catalog. Requires RED4ext, REDscript, TweakXL and M1 Arc 1.0.1+. CET is no longer required. Remove the old UndiscoverMe CET mod folder before installing.

UndiscoverMe_Teleporter.name: UndiscoverMe Teleporter
UndiscoverMe_Teleporter.summary: Optional UndiscoverMe-core addon: hold the map's Fast Travel action on an UndiscoverMe pin to teleport.

UndiscoverMe_Polish.name: UndiscoverMe — Polski
UndiscoverMe_Polish.summary: Polish text overlay for UndiscoverMe Core and its Teleporter addon.

UndiscoverMe_Korean.name: UndiscoverMe — 한국어
UndiscoverMe_Korean.summary: Korean text overlay for UndiscoverMe Core and its Teleporter addon.

UndiscoverMe_Translation_Sources.name: UndiscoverMe Translation Sources
UndiscoverMe_Translation_Sources.summary: Editable English, Polish and Korean JSON dictionaries for community translators; not a game mod.

Free_Chrome.name: Free Chrome — All Cyberware Costs 0 Humanity
Free_Chrome.summary: Sets standard cyberware Humanity/Capacity costs to zero, with reversible M1 Arc controls. Requires RED4ext, REDscript, TweakXL and M1 Arc 1.0.1+. CET is no longer required. Remove the old FreeChrome CET mod folder before installing; reload a save after changing the setting.

Camera_Killer.name: Camera Killer
Camera_Killer.summary: Shuts down connected surveillance cameras when V switches one off. Requires RED4ext, REDscript and M1 Arc 1.0.1+. CET is not required.

Weight_Customizer.name: Weight Customizer
Weight_Customizer.summary: Change V's carry capacity from 50 to 5000 kg through M1 Arc, with live updates and reversible modifiers.

Daemon.name: Daemon
Daemon.summary: Automatically solves Cyberpunk 2077 Breach Protocol puzzles by selecting valid cells in the original minigame. Requires M1 Arc 1.0.0.

NetDeck.name: NetWatch Σ MK.1
NetDeck.summary: NetWatch Σ MK.1 iconic cyberdeck with built-in NETWORM quickhack. Requires Phantom Liberty, Codeware, TweakXL, REDscript and M1 Arc 1.0.0.

Arc_Converter.name: Arc Converter - Automatic Item Processing
Arc_Converter.summary: Automatically sell or disassemble newly acquired weapons and clothes by tier, craft ammunition, and sell junk for eddies. Requires M1 Arc 1.0.0.

Tiny_Mike_Be_Gone.name: Tiny Mike Be Gone
Tiny_Mike_Be_Gone.summary: Remove Tiny Mike NPC from Afterlife club after his rescue gig. Requires REDscript only; no CET or M1 Arc.

Action_Blocked_Fix.name: Action Blocked Fix
Action_Blocked_Fix.summary: Automatically recovers the reproduced stuck NoCombat and NoZooming gameplay restriction pair. Requires REDscript only.
